Stated Claim / Post Context:
Alaska gubernatorial candidates discuss the state's energy future | Addressing Alaskans

Candidates Dave Bronson, Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins, Tregg Taylor and Bernadette Wilson discuss how they would help shape energy policy if elected governor.

Actual Article Body:
With elections coming up in November, energy costs and availability are a concern for many Alaskans. While there are three Republicans and one Democrat on the ballot, the candidates have different solutions for the state’s energy issues.

This episode features Alaska’s gubernatorial candidates discussing how they would help shape the state’s energy future. The forum featured all four candidates–Dave Bronson, Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins, Tregg Taylor and Bernadette Wilson. The forum was moderated by Alaska Public Media’s Lori Townsend.

The forum was recorded in the Wilda Marston Theatre on September 21, 2026. It was sponsored by the Alaska Municipal League, Alaska Power Association, New Energy Alaska, Alaska Village Electric Cooperative, CIRI, Doyon Limited and Renewable Energy Alaska Project.

The audio was improved for quality, but the content is unedited.
